HOW TO PLAY

Capture the grid

  1. Choose how many of your 10 pieces to send.
  2. Press SEND. The rival chooses secretly too.
  3. Higher number captures the territory. First to 3 wins.
  4. If the first 5 territories tie, both armies refill for 3 more.
